### One Body
Author: Kelly McFadden
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/one-body-homeword-july-.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 12:12
Points:
- Just like players on a sports team, every believer has a distinct and necessary role.
- Prominent leaders depend entirely on the support and contributions of others to function.
- True team players faithfully elevate others even when their service occurs away from the spotlight.
- Believers should resist envying the gifts of others and focus on utilizing their own to build up the church.

### For Pure Motives in Service
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-october-22-2021.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 12:18-20
Points:
- God deliberately designed a diverse body with varied personalities, responsibilities, and spiritual gifts under Christ.
- Diversity in the church provides continual opportunities to guide others and share one another's burdens.
- Believers must resist the urge to dominate others or enforce rigid uniformity.
- Ministry requires humility and servant-hearted authenticity rather than secular corporate control.
- Christians must rely on God's grace to serve with clean motives as clay in the Potter's hands.

### Partners of Equal Value
Author: Jim Liebelt
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/partners-of-equal-value-homeword-august-18.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 12:24-25
Points:
- Bickering over status and recognition wastes energy and undermines the church's witness to the world.
- The Holy Spirit equips each believer with gifts meant to build up and encourage the whole community.
- Different roles and abilities do not mean unequal value; all members remain essential partners.
- Believers are called to reject self-serving comparisons and follow Jesus in treating others with equal care and honor.
